title: Sunny Bowl x Cool AI - discovery

sentences.text: Thanks for making time. What's driving the timing on your side?
We're opening 40 locations in Texas and our creative is the bottleneck. It takes us weeks to produce new creative for each market.
We currently use Mediahub Local for local media, but reporting stops at clicks.
The goal is one campaign that every franchisee can localise. But our franchisees want to approve each offer, they don't want to lose control.
And honestly, how would we know it drove store visits? We'd need a holdout to prove incrementality.
We usually design the pilot with a holdout. What budget are you thinking for a first phase?
We have $180k set aside for a Q1 pilot. I sign off on media budget.
We'd want to launch on 2027-01-12 and run through 2027-03-31, across creative, local media and measurement.
Great. Next step: I'll send over a proposal and IO by Friday.
